description: Utility class for managing watch face configuration data via Google Wearable DataApi, including fetching, overwriting, and updating configuration DataMaps for a digital watch face.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing watch face configuration data via Google Wearable DataApi, including fetching, overwriting, and updating configuration DataMaps for a digital watch face.

methods.name: parseColor
methods.description: Converts a color name string to an integer color value using Color.parseColor.

methods.name: fetchConfigDataMap
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current configuration DataMap for the watch face and passes it to the callback.

methods.name: overwriteKeysInConfigDataMap
methods.description: Overwrites specific keys in the current configuration DataMap with new values.

methods.name: putConfigDataItem
methods.description: Creates or updates the configuration DataItem with the provided DataMap.
